files.snippet: ## Software Engineer | Game Developer C++ Unreal Engine 5 Blueprints GAS Gameplay Porting Consoles Systems CI/CD Build Systems Animation Programming Vulkan OpenGL Python HTML5 Linux **Software Engineer** with **9+ years of experience** specializing in software architecture, gameplay and systems programming, performance optimization, cross-platform development, and Modern C++ (17/20/23). Graphics API enthusiast with a custom **Vulkan 3D Game Engine**. I’ve taken part in multiple **AA/AAA Unreal Engine** projects across all production stages (pre-release, mid-production, and greenfield), such as **Lords of the Fallen** (2023, PS5, XSX, PC), **Gothic Remake** (2026, PS5, XSX, PC), and **Remothered Tormented Fathers Remaster** / **Remothered Broken Porcelain Remaster** (2026, PS5, XSX, Switch 2, PC). I bring a strong engineering mindset, adaptability, and a hands-on approach to solving complex technical challenges. - **Email:** [adrian.egea.comenge(at)gmail.com](adrian.egea.comenge(at)gmail.com) - **LinkedIn:** [www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-egea-comenge](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-egea-comenge) Download CV pdf ## Profesional Projects ### Lords of the Fallen (2023) HexWorks (CI Games) ARPG Soulslike Multiplayer Coop Unreal Engine 5 PS5 XSX PC - Designed, implemented, and maintained core software systems for **Lords of the Fallen** (2023, PS5, XSX, PC), including quest management, save-game persistence, and data serialization, supporting dozens of quests and their variants. - Developed gameplay systems involving inventory management, character statistics, Niagara VFX and Wwise audio integration. - Contributed to multiplayer networking, state replication, and gameplay ability systems (GAS). - Investigated and resolved critical software defects during development and post-release maintenance, including patches and DLCs. - Optimized multithreaded asynchronous asset and data loading, and improved gameplay performance using asynchronous Ability Tasks (GAS). > [Lords Of The Fallen V 2.5 | Full Game | Longplay Walkthrough Gameplay No Commentary](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JsdvaonJiLk) ### Gothic 1 Remake (2026) Alkimia Interactive (THQ Nordic) ARPG Single Player Unreal Engine 5 PS5 XSX PC - Worked on **Gothic Remake** (2026; PS5, XSX, PC). - Developed character and creature movement systems and animation-related functionality for quadrupeds. - Migrated existing ALS Plugin implementation to C++ to improve code performance and maintainability. - Implemented and debugged AI functionality for small creature behaviors (birds, rats, fish...). - Contributed to movement systems and gameplay abilities within an established software architecture. > [GOTHIC 1 REMAKE Gameplay Walkthrough FULL GAME (4K 60FPS) No Commentary](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rtLSazl7pd8) ### Quest System for Unannounced Project (2024) Underdog Studio (CI Games) Third Person Action Multiplayer Coop Unreal Engine 5 FlowGraph PS5 XSX PC - Quest System based in FlowGraph plugin with network replication for Coop mode. > [GitHub - MothCocoon/FlowGraph: Design-agnostic node system for scripting game’s flow in Unreal Engine](https://github.com/MothCocoon/FlowGraph) ### Modding System for Unannounced Project (2025) GRIP Studios Third Person Simulation Unreal Engine 5 Mod.io PS5 XSX PC - Designed and implemented a **Modding system** supporting PC and console platforms for unannounced **Simulation** project (PC, PS5, XSX). - Modding System based in [Mod.io](https://mod.io/). > [GitHub - modio/modio-ue: Unreal Engine Plugin for easily integrating mod.io into your game - the UGC management service for game developers](https://github.com/modio/modio-ue) ### Remothered Remastered (2026) Radical Dreams Entertainment 株式会社 Port Horror Unreal Engine 5 PS5 XSX Switch2 PC - Developed cross-platform **Remaster** ports for **Remothered Tormented Fathers** and **Remothered Broken Porcelain** (PC, PS5, XSX, Switch 2). - Contributed to **porting** existing software to Unreal Engine 5 and resolving platform-specific issues. - Implemented and maintained gameplay and system-level functionality, UI components, and cinematic systems. - Set up **CI/CD** infrastructure using **TeamCity** and **Docker** to support automated builds and development workflows. > [Remothered Remastered - Announcement Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ju3fe6C96uA) ### Cl3ver (2018) Cl3ver C++ OpenGL - Responsible for creation of Plugins for Rhinoceros and Google Sketchup. Responsible for refactoring and implementing new features for Oculus Rift App. > [CL3VER | Real-time Cloud RTX Rendering on Google Cloud](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C3ntpWgNbGw) ## Side Projects ### **C++ / OpenGL / Vulkan 3D Game Engine** C++ OpenGL Vulkan GLSL - Custom Vulkan 3D engine built for graphics and systems learning and research. Made with C++, CMake, Python, Vulkan, OpenGL 4.x, GLSL, SPIRV. [GitHub Repo](https://github.com/adrianensis/ForestEngine) - **Features**: 2D, 3D, Hybrid ECS, Automatic Batching, Instanced Rendering, Data Driven Shaders Builder, Texture Atlases, Animation Spritesheets, Built-In Custom UI, Scene management, Perspective / Orthographic Camera, Stencil, Basic Input, Events Manager, Math module, Loading 3D models with GLTF, Skeletal Meshes, Skeletal Animation, GPU Skinning, Render Graph, Render Passes, PBR Shading, Directional Light, Shadow Mapping, Materials system, Custom Smart Pointers > [C++ / OpenGL / Vulkan 3D Game Engine](https://github.com/adrianensis/ForestEngine) ### **JavaScript + WebGL 2D Game Engine** JavaScript WebGL GLSL - Lightweight Web 2D engine. JavaScript, WebGL, GLSL. [GitHub Repo](https://github.com/adrianensis/ThiefEngine) - **Features**: 2D, Texture Atlases, Animation Spritesheets, Scene management, Orthographic Camera, Basic Input > [JavaScript + WebGL 2D Game Engine](https://github.com/adrianensis/ThiefEngine) ### **Game AI Project** Java LibGDX State Machines Flocking Pathfinding (A*) Steering Behaviors Game AI * Implementation of autonomous agent behaviors and navigation algorithms. [GitHub Repo](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/adrianensis/AI-Videogames-2016) * **Tech**: Java * **Features**: Pathfinding A*, Flocking, State Machines, Steering Behaviours > [Game AI Project](https://github.com/adrianensis/Artificial-Intelligence-Videogames-2016) ### Transpiler - Custom C++-Like Language C++ CMake * Simplified C++ to modern C++ transpiler. [GitHub Repo](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/adrianensis/Compiler) * **Features**: Lexer, Parser, AST, Semantic Analisys, Code Generation ### RSS to Markdown Python tool Python HTML CSS JSON XML * Python script that download RSS info in Markdown format. [GitHub Repo](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/adrianensis/rss-to-md) * **Tech**: Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, XML * **Features**: RSS download, RSS Cache, Human-like behaviour to avoid bans, categories ### Markdown to HTML Python tool Python HTML CSS JSON * Convert Markdown to HTML. [GitHub Repo](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/adrianensis/md-to-html) * **Features**: sidebar navigation tree, sidebar table of content, pretty link cards, search bar
